Our Commitment to Transparency

OUR VISION

Real People. Verified Debts. Direct Payments.

At DebtFreeLately, we believe that meaningful financial support begins with trust.

Our planned verification process is intended to help assess whether people requesting support are genuine, review debt information carefully, and direct contributions toward confirmed financial obligations.

Where we are today

The current app supports email verification and admin review of submitted cards. Government ID checks, supporting-document uploads, independent creditor confirmation and payment processing are not yet available. Admin approval is not identity or debt verification, and the app does not currently transfer money.

How We Plan to Build Trust

  1. 1

    Identity Verification

    The planned process would require members requesting support to verify their identity using valid government-issued identification and additional identity checks.

  2. 2

    Debt Documentation

    Applicants would provide relevant financial documents to support their debt claims, including the amount owed and creditor details.

  3. 3

    Independent Creditor Confirmation

    We aim to independently confirm debt information with the relevant creditor, including the outstanding amount and approved payment details.

  4. 4

    Transparent Verification Status

    Debt listings would display their verification status so supporters can understand the level of review completed. Today, an approved card indicates admin review only.

  5. 5

    Direct-to-Creditor Payments

    Our intended payment model would direct financial contributions to verified creditors through an authorised payment process, rather than paying the person requesting assistance directly.

  6. 6

    Payment Confirmation

    Once payment processing is available, supporters would receive confirmation of completed payments, while debt balances would be updated based on verified payment records.

Transparency Without Sacrificing Privacy

We believe financial transparency should never require unnecessary public exposure of personal information.

Members control which eligible personal details they choose to display publicly. Sensitive verification documents are intended to remain restricted when document verification is introduced.
